question: Could fully shared island-year census error, in the absence of biological island coherence, generate the observed same-island annual covariance contrast?

latent_null.biological_structure: Use the exact eligible colony trajectories and missingness from the frozen island-year coherence analysis, but permute static island labels within the same five coverage/abundance rank strata used by that analysis before adding measurement error.
latent_null.purpose: Break the observed colony-to-island biological alignment while preserving each colony time series, abundance scale, coverage and the island-size composition of the null assignment.

measurement_error.family: mean-one lognormal multiplicative factor shared perfectly by every reported colony assigned to the same pseudo-island in the same census year
measurement_error.construction: For CV c, sigma2=log(1+c^2); multiply each observed colony count at island i/year t by exp(N(-sigma2/2,sigma2)). Missing rows remain missing. Recompute annual growth, colony standardization, regional-year residualization and the exact frozen covariance contrast.
measurement_error.rationale: This is deliberately favorable to the observer-error alternative because all colonies within an island share the full annual multiplicative error.

simulation.label_permutation: new stratified pseudo-island assignment per replicate
simulation.error_draw: new shared island-year factors per replicate

decision_rules.strong_robustness: For every fixed CV through 0.20, upper-tail probability P(simulated contrast >= observed) <= 0.05.
decision_rules.moderate_robustness: Strong robustness fails, but every fixed CV through 0.10 has upper-tail probability <= 0.05.
decision_rules.no_threshold_interpolation: Report the predeclared grid only; do not tune intermediate CV values after outcomes.

four_island_no_litchfield.rule: repeat the same fixed CV grid after excluding Litchfield; report but do not use to override the primary five-island classification

interpretation_boundaries: These CV values are sensitivity scenarios, not estimates of actual Palmer LTER observer error.
Failure to reproduce the observed contrast under this model does not rule out all forms of survey bias, code-boundary changes or spatially structured observation error.
A result robust to fully shared island-year multiplicative error strengthens the demographic-coherence interpretation but does not identify its biological mechanism.
Do not change the error family, CV grid, permutation strata, replicate count, target statistic or decision thresholds after outcomes are opened.
